author: BELLjr8
quote:
As someone who isn't a souls fan it's shocking how much I love this game. It never feels unfair like most. And has a difficulty option if you simply cannot get past something. 
The art style is beautiful, the combat is very satisfying, the loot system brilliant, story intriguing. Just an amazing game all round. A shame it has been largely overlooked.

author: BELLjr8
quote: A true masterpiece of gaming! Simy the best visuals and performance of any console game! A beautiful atmosphere that does justice to the theme and era of the games setting. Combat is the highlight though, very satisfying, with enough of a challenge to keep you engages but not frustrate. Leveling and progression done amazing too. Side activities a little generic but fit the atmosphere so well they are relaxing and enjoyable anyway. Side quests more interesting telling you more about main characters and giving good rewards. I simply cannot praise this game enough.
